title: Classes and Ids
story: A class (.note) can style many elements. An id (#hero) styles exactly one.
goal: Give every .note a yellow-ish background (not white or transparent), and make #hero text centred.

tests.label: Both notes have a background colour
tests.js: return $$(".note").every(function (n) { var c = css(n,"background-color"); return c !== "" && c !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)" && c !== "rgb(255, 255, 255)"; }) || "a note has no background"

tests.label: The plain paragraph has no background
tests.js: var c = css($$("p")[1],"background-color"); return c === "" || c === "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)" || c === "rgb(255, 255, 255)" || c

hints: A class selector starts with a dot, an id selector with a hash.
